$comment: Pinned contract for roadmap-blitz: C2 (roadmap-blitz.mjs), C3 (emit-roadmap-fire.py) and C4 (SKILL.md) build against it; C7 and C8 load it as their shape oracle. The five seam args (repoRoot, sizing, interactionMode, approver, trailDir) are the ones warp's roadmap arm passes; the rest, pluginRoot included, are DoE-side optionals warp never passes (absent, the briefs tell the agents to resolve the plugin root). `approver`, when supplied, must equal approverFor(interactionMode) or the run throws. `stage` holds the roadmap.blitz_stage reply fields read at claude-klabauter ffdf5f52 (coordinator_core/ops/roadmap_blitz_stage.py docstring). Values below are examples of each shape; enumerated alternatives are listed in `_enums`.

approval.utterance: The approver's verbatim words approving or declining the roadmap.
The approver's verbatim words approving or declining the roadmap.
